title: ASTRA-66 example_bench_record.csv: COLUMN TEMPLATE with SYNTHETIC values, NOT a measurement
truth_profile: synthetic analytic test profile (boost / coast / 5 m/s descent; numbers chosen for software testing only)
notes: Sensor values come from the Phase 4 simulated sensors (seeded noise). Noise, drift, discharge and parachute swing are illustrative assumptions, not properties of any component.
GNSS positions are relative to a fictitious origin (0 deg, 0 deg) with synthetic drift.
purpose: Column template for bench records (avionics/bench_data/README.md). The values are synthetic (generated by the simulated sensors), so data_source is SYNTHETIC. A genuine bench recording must set data_source to BENCH in every row and come with its own meta file.
